name: Meta AI
summary: Meta's assistant (app and meta.ai). Image generation is free and runs on Muse Image; you can also make short AI videos ("vibes"). Meta One plans raise the limits.

video.arena_note: Meta doesn't say whether free accounts get Muse Video.

source_note: meta.ai ("create AI-generated images for free"), Meta AI and Vibes Help Center, and Meta's Muse Image announcement, checked 2026-09-29.
